parties.petitioner_plaintiff: ADAM B CHAKI, Versus GOVERNMENT OF INDIA THROUGH SECRETARY & ANR.
parties.respondent_defendant: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA THROUGH SECRETARY & ANR.

facts_of_case: Two Public Interest Litigations were filed. One prayed for mandamus or other appropriate writ to implement the Scheme for Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students Belonging to Minority Communities, while the other prayed for declaration that the benefit of the Scheme should be extended to all eligible students.

legal_principles.principle: Treating unequals equally would not amount to discrimination.
legal_principles.held: The existing inequalities have to be considered and accordingly an affirmative action has been taken in a manner conducive and ultimately to build up of an egalitarian non-discriminating society.

legal_principles.principle: When facilities are given and expenditure is incurred by the Central and State Governments to other religions, there would not be discrimination.
legal_principles.held: The Supreme Court in the judgment of Praful Goralia (supra) has held that when such facilities are given and expenditure is incurred by the Central and State Governments to other religions, there would not be discrimination.

legal_principles.principle: If the Union of India can frame an Act for the benefit of minorities, it is incorrect to say that, the Union of India cannot frame a policy to confer scholarships to the students of minority community.
legal_principles.held: That apart, when other similarly situated persons/students are also given similar benefits, there is no question of discrimination.
